application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension. Detached outbuilding in the rear garden. Excavation of a basement floor with front light well.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Location Plan, PAR/00, PAR/10, PAR/12, Design and Access and heritage statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Method Statement & Tree Protection Plan, Flood Risk Assessment 3335/RE/11-23/01 and Fire Safety Statement. Received: 4/12/2023
PAR/17 and PAR/50. Received: 1/2/2024
PAR/01, PAR/15 and PAR/16. Received: 11/3/2024

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes).
Condition : 5 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 6 - No development of the basement shall take place until a Construction Method Statement (CMS) relating to the basement hereby approved has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority. The CMS shall be certified by a qualified professional and give details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area. The approved CMS shall be adhered to throughout the construction period for the development of the basement.
